limitations.detail: Unannotated source-320 and installed-390 overview viewport PNGs have an empty graph area despite current-frame Canvas2D label records. Immediately following full-page and boundary PNGs, and selected PNGs, render the graph. Those blank originals are retained. This proves the current-frame API is insufficient by itself to certify every raster capture; this bounded run does not establish whether screenshot timing/compositing or an intermittent application paint issue caused the discrepancy. No unconditional all-state pixel pass is claimed. Only those two affected cells were recaptured. Both now have positive actual raster proof immediately before final capture, and both final PNGs were independently viewed as populated. This closes the matched visual evidence gap for these states without erasing the initial failed captures or establishing their underlying paint/timing cause.
